proof_body:
by
  intro a b M h hb
  have h₂ : Filter.Tendsto (fun n => M * |b n|) Filter.atTop (nhds 0) := by
    simpa using hb.abs.const_mul M
  refine squeeze_zero_norm (fun n => ?_) h₂
  rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_mul]
  exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (h n) (abs_nonneg _)
target_source: ∀ (a b : ℕ → ℝ) (M : ℝ), (∀ n, |a n| ≤ M) → Filter.Tendsto b Filter.atTop (nhds 0) → Filter.Tendsto (fun n => a n * b n) Filter.atTop (nhds 0)
